question: Which of the following teams did Tamil Nadu defeat in the final to win the men's title in he 71st$ Senior National Basketball Championship 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Punjab**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Tamil Nadu defeated Punjab in the final match to secure the men's title in the **71st Senior National Basketball Championship 2022**.
 
• The final game took place at **Chennai, Tamil Nadu**, where the championship was hosted.
 
• Tamil Nadu showcased exceptional performance, winning the men's title with a scoreline of **87-69** against Punjab.
 
• The victory highlighted Tamil Nadu's dominance in the basketball circuit in India.
 
• This championship is one of the prestigious national-level tournaments in basketball, organized under the aegis of the **Basketball Federation of India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Basketball Federation of India (BFI):**

 
 
• The BFI is the governing body for basketball in India and is responsible for organizing national-level tournaments like the Senior National Basketball Championship.
 
• Founded in 1950, it works to promote basketball across the country and represents India in international basketball events.
 
 
 
• **Significance of the Senior National Basketball Championship:**
 
 
• This championship provides a platform for players from different states to showcase their talent and compete at the highest level in India.
 
• It is considered a crucial event for the selection of players for the national basketball team.
 
 
 
• **Basketball in India:**
 
 
• Basketball has been growing steadily in popularity, especially among youth, due to increased exposure to international leagues like the NBA.
 
• India has been making efforts to improve infrastructure and coaching standards to develop basketball at grassroots levels.
 
 
 
• **Tamil Nadu's Basketball Legacy:**
 
 
• Tamil Nadu has traditionally been one of the strongholds in Indian basketball, consistently performing well in national championships.
 
• The state has produced several talented players who have represented India at international levels.
